Subject: CSA questionnaire — kickoff and target date

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this. We're running a CSA assessment for our procurement board and need your CAIQ responses and supporting evidence to close the security review. Target: vendor packet due by EOD Friday (2026-09-17).

High level ask: completed CAIQ PDF/Excel mapping + PDF index of evidentiary artifacts (screenshots, configs, SOC/SIG attachments, audit logs pointers).

Can you confirm a point of contact, per-control owner mapping, and if Redwood can deliver direct download links or a zipped evidence bundle? Our review team will spot-check a subset.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Hi David / Acme team,

Thanks — we can meet the Friday deadline. I'm the primary POC for this questionnaire. Below is our proposed approach and timeline:

- Today (Mon): intake and owner assignment; create mapping workbook.
- Tue–Wed: owners gather artifacts and produce screenshots/config extracts.
- Thu: internal review and finalize mapping workbook.
- Fri (EOD): deliver CAIQ mapping + evidence index and share Drive links; attach zipped bundle on request.

We can provide direct Drive links to artifacts and a single zipped bundle if you need offline delivery. For controls that require dynamic evidence (e.g., audit log extracts, retention configuration), we typically provide redacted exports and step-by-step reproduction notes.

I'll loop in control owners for the specific sections. If Acme has any must-check controls, call them out now and we'll prioritize.

Best,

Team — Acme wants the CAIQ mapping and evidence by EOD Friday. I split the control groups below. Please reply with any blockers by EOD today.

- Rishi (rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai): Governance & Risk controls (CCM: GRC, Policies, Vendor mgmt) — gather policy PDFs, change-control logs, risk register excerpt. Due: Wed 09/16 17:00 PT.
- Stephanie (stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai): Identity, Access Management, and Logging controls (IAM, Privilege, MFA, Audit logs) — provide screenshots of Okta/SCIM sync, sample audit export (redacted), and IAM policy docs. Due: Thu 09/16 12:00 PT.
- Alex (alex.martinez@redwood.ai): Infrastructure & Data Protection controls (encryption at rest/in transit, backups, KMS integration) — attach KMS config snippets, backup retention summary, and network diagrams. Due: Thu 09/16 17:00 PT.

Notes: keep file names in the format acme_<control>_<artifact> and include a one-line description in the evidence index for each artifact. We will produce redwood_acme_csa_mapping_v1.xlsx and an evidence_index_v1.pdf.

If anyone expects to miss a deadline, escalate to me immediately so we can request a short extension.

Thanks — V
